verdicts.reading: The integrated memory phase is a conserved quantity: over the full line it equals (pi/2) ln[chi(inf)/chi(0)] exactly (lead-lag to 7e-08; waterbed redistribution changes the phase shape by 0.17 rad pointwise yet moves the area by only 9e-09).  On real data the banded budget classifies the gain: the ocean modulus pays its full Bode phase (area 6.04 vs endpoint prediction 5.65, 6% closure) -- causal memory; the solar pair's phase area (0.213) is pure transport (0.207, tau_d = -10.3 s), while a causal reading of its gain tilt would demand 0.76 -- 3.5x too much -- so that tilt is static per-mode weighting, gain without phase, the elliptic continuum.
